INT1.label: Cancel or Terminate

INT1.1.label: Cancel subscription
INT1.1.description: Customer wants to cancel an ongoing subscription or recurring service.

INT1.2.label: Close account
INT1.2.description: Customer wants to permanently close or delete their account.

INT1.3.label: Cancel order or booking
INT1.3.description: Customer wants to cancel a one-time order, booking, or purchase before fulfilment.

INT1.4.label: Opt out of service or feature
INT1.4.description: Customer wants to stop receiving a specific service, feature, or communication they are enrolled in.

INT1.description: The customer wants to end a subscription, close an account, cancel an order, or opt out of a service.

INT2.label: Refund or Financial Reversal

INT2.1.label: Request refund
INT2.1.description: Customer wants a monetary refund for a charge already paid.

INT2.2.label: Reverse or dispute charge
INT2.2.description: Customer wants a specific charge removed or reversed, particularly one they believe is incorrect.

INT2.3.label: Waive fee or penalty
INT2.3.description: Customer wants a late fee, cancellation fee, or similar penalty waived.

INT2.4.label: Request account credit
INT2.4.description: Customer wants credit applied to their account rather than a cash refund.

INT2.description: The customer wants money returned, a charge reversed, a fee waived, or account credit applied.

INT3.label: Restore Access

INT3.1.label: Reset password or credentials
INT3.1.description: Customer wants to reset a password, PIN, or security credentials.

INT3.2.label: Unlock account
INT3.2.description: Customer's account has been locked or suspended and they want it restored.

INT3.3.label: Reactivate subscription
INT3.3.description: Customer wants to reinstate a subscription that has lapsed or been cancelled.

INT3.4.label: Recover account access
INT3.4.description: Customer cannot access their account due to lost credentials, changed email, or ownership dispute.

INT3.description: The customer wants to regain access to their account, subscription, or a feature they are locked out of.

INT4.label: Update Account or Profile

INT4.1.label: Update payment method
INT4.1.description: Customer wants to change or add a payment method or billing details.

INT4.2.label: Change email or username
INT4.2.description: Customer wants to update their primary email address or account username.

INT4.3.label: Update personal information
INT4.3.description: Customer wants to change name, address, phone number, or other personal details.

INT4.4.label: Change notification or communication preferences
INT4.4.description: Customer wants to adjust how and when they receive emails, alerts, or marketing.

INT4.5.label: Link or unlink account
INT4.5.description: Customer wants to connect or disconnect a third-party account, institution, or integration.

INT4.description: The customer wants to change information stored on their account or update their preferences.

INT5.label: Get Information or Check Status

INT5.1.label: Check status of request or order
INT5.1.description: Customer wants to know where a previous request, order, or case stands.

INT5.2.label: Understand a charge or invoice
INT5.2.description: Customer wants an explanation of a specific charge, fee, or invoice line item.

INT5.3.label: Clarify policy or terms
INT5.3.description: Customer wants to understand a policy, terms of service, or eligibility rule.

INT5.4.label: Confirm account details
INT5.4.description: Customer wants to verify information currently on their account.

INT5.5.label: Track progress of previous support request
INT5.5.description: Customer is following up on an open case or ticket they already submitted.

INT5.description: The customer wants information, clarification, or a status update — no account change required.

INT6.label: Report a Problem

INT6.1.label: Report technical bug or error
INT6.1.description: Customer has encountered a software error, crash, or unexpected behaviour.

INT6.2.label: Report missing or incorrect content
INT6.2.description: Customer found that content (document, article, data) is missing, wrong, or inaccessible.

INT6.3.label: Report account discrepancy
INT6.3.description: Customer sees incorrect information in their account — wrong balance, wrong record, wrong status.

INT6.4.label: Report inappropriate or abusive content
INT6.4.description: Customer wants to flag content that violates terms of service or community standards.

INT6.description: The customer wants to flag an issue, error, or discrepancy they have encountered.

INT7.label: Dispute or Appeal a Decision

INT7.1.label: Dispute charge or invoice
INT7.1.description: Customer believes a charge is incorrect and wants it reviewed or reversed.

INT7.2.label: Appeal account restriction or suspension
INT7.2.description: Customer's account has been restricted or suspended and they want the decision reviewed.

INT7.3.label: Contest content removal or moderation action
INT7.3.description: Customer's content was removed or actioned and they want to challenge the decision.

INT7.4.label: Escalate unresolved complaint
INT7.4.description: Customer has already raised an issue and it has not been resolved; they want senior escalation.

INT7.description: The customer wants to challenge or overturn a decision made by the service or platform.

INT8.label: Technical Fix or Workaround

INT8.1.label: Fix broken feature or functionality
INT8.1.description: A specific feature is not working and the customer wants it restored.

INT8.2.label: Troubleshoot connectivity or access error
INT8.2.description: Customer cannot connect to or load the service and needs help diagnosing the cause.

INT8.3.label: Request configuration change
INT8.3.description: Customer wants a setting or configuration adjusted that they cannot change themselves.

INT8.4.label: Request workaround or interim solution
INT8.4.description: A fix is not immediately available; customer wants an alternative way to accomplish their goal.

INT8.description: The customer needs a technical problem diagnosed and fixed, or a workaround put in place.

INT9.label: Data Export or Document Request

INT9.1.label: Export personal or account data
INT9.1.description: Customer wants a copy of all data the service holds on them (e.g. GDPR subject access request).

INT9.2.label: Download invoice or receipt
INT9.2.description: Customer wants a copy of a specific invoice, receipt, or billing document.

INT9.3.label: Request official confirmation or letter
INT9.3.description: Customer wants an official document confirming account status, ownership, or transaction history.

INT9.description: The customer wants to obtain a copy of data, a document, or a record associated with their account.

INT10.label: Change Plan or Subscription Tier

INT10.1.label: Upgrade plan
INT10.1.description: Customer wants to move to a higher-tier or more feature-rich plan.

INT10.2.label: Downgrade plan
INT10.2.description: Customer wants to move to a lower-tier or lower-cost plan.

INT10.3.label: Add feature or add-on
INT10.3.description: Customer wants to add an optional feature, seat, or add-on product.

INT10.4.label: Remove feature or add-on
INT10.4.description: Customer wants to remove an optional feature or add-on from their subscription.

INT10.5.label: Switch billing cycle
INT10.5.description: Customer wants to change between monthly and annual billing, or adjust their billing date.

INT10.description: The customer wants to move to a different plan, tier, or product variant.
